name: fn_runtime_chain_fingerprint
text:
CREATE DEFINER=`root`@`localhost` FUNCTION `fn_runtime_chain_fingerprint`(
    p_id_tenant BIGINT,
    p_id_usuario BIGINT,
    p_id_sessao BIGINT,
    p_id_dispositivo BIGINT,
    p_estado VARCHAR(60)
) RETURNS char(64) CHARSET utf8mb4
    DETERMINISTIC
RETURN SHA2(
    CONCAT(
        IFNULL(p_id_tenant,''),
        '|',
        IFNULL(p_id_usuario,''),
        '|',
        IFNULL(p_id_sessao,''),
        '|',
        IFNULL(p_id_dispositivo,''),
        '|',
        IFNULL(p_estado,'')
    ),256) ;;
